features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You learn and cast spells from the Wizard spell list (mostly Enchantment and Illusion), using Intelligence. One-third caster; one of your cantrips is Mage Hand.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.desc: Your Mage Hand is Invisible and can perform Sleight of Hand: plant or steal objects, pick locks, and disarm traps at a distance.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.desc: If you are hidden when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on its saving throw against that spell.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you use your Mage Hand to distract a creature within 5 feet of the hand, gaining Advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of the turn.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.desc: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell (or its caster misses you with it), you can use your Reaction to steal the spell: the caster can't use it, and you can cast it until your next Long Rest. Once per Long Rest.
